indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX broker_acquisitions_pkey ON public.broker_acquisitions USING btree (chain_id, transaction_hash, log_index)
CREATE INDEX broker_acquisitions_punk_time_idx ON public.broker_acquisitions USING btree (chain_id, punk_collection_address, punk_token_id, acquired_at DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX broker_automation_v3_worker_runs_pkey ON public.broker_automation_v3_worker_runs USING btree (run_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX broker_automation_v3_worker_r_release_commit_started_at_com_key ON public.broker_automation_v3_worker_runs USING btree (release_commit, started_at, completed_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX broker_automation_v3_worker_runs_transaction_idx ON public.broker_automation_v3_worker_runs USING btree (transaction_hash) WHERE (transaction_hash IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX broker_automation_v3_worker_runs_completed_idx ON public.broker_automation_v3_worker_runs USING btree (completed_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX broker_automation_v3_worker_runs_lane_completed_idx ON public.broker_automation_v3_worker_runs USING btree (lane_id, completed_at DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX broker_v2_activity_pkey ON public.broker_v2_activity USING btree (activity_id)
CREATE INDEX broker_v2_activity_punk_idx ON public.broker_v2_activity USING btree (chain_id, punk_token_id, occurred_at DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX broker_v2_activity_collected_attempt_uidx ON public.broker_v2_activity USING btree (attempt_id) WHERE ((attempt_id IS NOT NULL) AND ((activity_type)::text = 'COLLECTED'::text))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX broker_v2_model_registry_pkey ON public.broker_v2_model_registry USING btree (registry_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX broker_v2_model_registry_provider_model_id_key ON public.broker_v2_model_registry USING btree (provider, model_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX broker_v2_provider_usage_pkey ON public.broker_v2_provider_usage USING btree (usage_id)
CREATE INDEX broker_v2_provider_usage_recent_idx ON public.broker_v2_provider_usage USING btree (occurred_at DESC, provider, task)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX broker_v2_strategies_pkey ON public.broker_v2_strategies USING btree (chain_id, collection_address, token_id, version)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX broker_v2_strategies_intent_hash_key ON public.broker_v2_strategies USING btree (intent_hash)
CREATE INDEX broker_v2_strategies_active_idx ON public.broker_v2_strategies USING btree (chain_id, state, expires_at, token_id)
